```{r load}
log_open("07")
P <- readRDS(file.path(RES, "prepared.rds"))
MODELS <- list(corr3  = list(DEP = DEP, ANX = ANX, STR = STR),
               unidim = list(G = 1:21))
```

**Sequence** (lecture 9, "typical steps"): configural → metric (equal loadings)
→ scalar (equal loadings and thresholds) → strict (additionally equal residual
variances). WLSMV on the four-category data.

* Configural, metric and scalar are fitted in the **delta** parameterisation.
  The identification constraints are written out explicitly in the model syntax
  (function `mg_syntax`) rather than left to lavaan's defaults:
  group 1 always has latent means 0, latent variances 1 and scale factors 1;
  with equal loadings the latent variances of group 2 are freed; with equal
  thresholds the latent means and the scale factors of group 2 are freed.
  (Items whose thresholds are released in the partial model keep their scale
  factor fixed at 1, as it is not identified otherwise.)
* Residual variances are not parameters in the delta parameterisation, so the
  strict step is fitted in the **theta** parameterisation. The scalar model is
  refitted in theta to confirm that both parameterisations give the identical
  scalar fit, so the strict step is compared against exactly the same model.
* Decisions: ΔCFI ≥ −.010 and ΔRMSEA ≤ .015; for unequal group sizes the stricter
  −.005 / .010 (Chen, 2007). Scaled χ² difference tests are reported alongside.
  Lecture 9 recommends comparing the scalar model **directly with the configural
  model** for threshold models; that comparison is reported as well.
* Two families of approximate fit indices are reported: `*.scaled` (from the
  scaled-and-shifted statistic) and `*.robust` (lavaan's robust versions for
  categorical data). They answer the same question but can differ noticeably for
  WLSMV; the essay must use one family consistently.

```{r mi-function}
# Multi-group syntax with explicit identification.
#   level: "configural", "metric", "scalar" or "strict"
#   param: "delta" or "theta";  free_thr: items whose thresholds differ by group
mg_syntax <- function(factors, level, param = "delta", free_thr = character(0)) {
  eqL <- level != "configural"
  eqT <- level %in% c("scalar", "strict")
  L <- character(0)
  for (f in names(factors)) {
    its <- paste0("dass", factors[[f]])
    lab <- if (eqL) sprintf("c(l_%s, l_%s)*%s", its, its, its)
           else     sprintf("c(l_%s_g1, l_%s_g2)*%s", its, its, its)
    L <- c(L, paste0(f, " =~ ", paste(lab, collapse = " + ")),
           sprintf("%s ~~ c(1, %s)*%s", f, if (eqL) "NA" else "1", f),
           sprintf("%s ~ c(0, %s)*1",   f, if (eqT) "NA" else "0"))
  }
  for (it in ITEMS) {
    same <- eqT && !(it %in% free_thr)
    th <- sapply(1:3, function(k) if (same) sprintf("c(t_%s_%d, t_%s_%d)*t%d", it, k, it, k, k)
                                  else      sprintf("c(t_%s_%d_g1, t_%s_%d_g2)*t%d", it, k, it, k, k))
    L <- c(L, paste0(it, " | ", paste(th, collapse = " + ")))
    if (param == "delta")
      L <- c(L, sprintf("%s ~*~ c(1, %s)*%s", it, if (same) "NA" else "1", it))
    else
      L <- c(L, sprintf("%s ~~ c(1, %s)*%s", it, if (same && level != "strict") "NA" else "1", it))
  }
  paste(L, collapse = "\n")
}
fit_mg <- function(factors, d, level, param = "delta", free_thr = character(0))
  lavaan::cfa(mg_syntax(factors, level, param, free_thr), data = d, group = "grp",
              group.label = levels(d$grp), ordered = ITEMS, estimator = "WLSMV",
              parameterization = param, std.lv = FALSE, auto.fix.first = FALSE)

FM <- c("chisq", "chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "pvalue.scaled", "cfi.scaled",
        "rmsea.scaled", "cfi.robust", "rmsea.robust", "srmr")
fmeas <- function(f) setNames(lavaan::fitMeasures(f)[FM], FM)

mi_sequence <- function(model, grp, label) {
  keep <- !is.na(grp)
  d <- data.frame(P$items[keep, ], grp = droplevels(grp[keep]))
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s: %s ===\n", label, paste(names(table(d$grp)), table(d$grp), collapse = " / ")))
  f <- list(
    configural   = fit_mg(model, d, "configural"),
    metric       = fit_mg(model, d, "metric"),
    scalar       = fit_mg(model, d, "scalar"),
    scalar_theta = fit_mg(model, d, "scalar", "theta"),
    strict       = fit_mg(model, d, "strict", "theta"))
  cat("df configural / metric / scalar / strict:",
      sapply(f[c("configural", "metric", "scalar", "strict")], lavaan::fitMeasures, "df"), "\n")
  tab <- as.data.frame(t(sapply(f, fmeas)))
  tab$converged <- sapply(f, lavaan::lavInspect, "converged")
  print(round(tab, 4))
  cat("Scalar fit identical in delta and theta parameterisation:",
      isTRUE(abs(tab["scalar", "chisq.scaled"] - tab["scalar_theta", "chisq.scaled"]) < 1e-3), "\n")
  cat("Unscaled chi2 monotone across steps:",
      all(diff(tab[c("configural", "metric", "scalar", "strict"), "chisq"]) > 0), "\n")

  comp <- function(a, b) {
    lrt <- lavaan::lavTestLRT(f[[a]], f[[b]])
    data.frame(comparison = paste(a, "->", b),
               dchisq = lrt[2, "Chisq diff"], ddf = lrt[2, "Df diff"], p = lrt[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"],
               dCFI_scaled = tab[b, "cfi.scaled"] - tab[a, "cfi.scaled"],
               dRMSEA_scaled = tab[b, "rmsea.scaled"] - tab[a, "rmsea.scaled"],
               dCFI_robust = tab[b, "cfi.robust"] - tab[a, "cfi.robust"],
               dRMSEA_robust = tab[b, "rmsea.robust"] - tab[a, "rmsea.robust"])
  }
  deltas <- rbind(comp("configural", "metric"), comp("metric", "scalar"),
                  comp("scalar_theta", "strict"), comp("configural", "scalar"))
  print(format(deltas, digits = 3))

  pe <- lavaan::parameterEstimates(f$scalar)
  lv <- unique(pe$lhs[pe$op == "=~"])
  lat <- data.frame(factor = lv,
    mean_g2 = sapply(lv, function(v) pe$est[pe$op == "~1" & pe$lhs == v & pe$group == 2]),
    se      = sapply(lv, function(v) pe$se[pe$op == "~1" & pe$lhs == v & pe$group == 2]),
    var_g2  = sapply(lv, function(v) pe$est[pe$op == "~~" & pe$lhs == v & pe$rhs == v & pe$group == 2]))
  lat$z <- lat$mean_g2 / lat$se; lat$p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(lat$z)); lat$sd_ratio <- sqrt(lat$var_g2)
  cat("\nLatent means of group 2 (group 1 = 0, SD 1), scalar model:\n"); print(format(lat, digits = 3))
  list(fits = f, tab = tab, deltas = deltas, latent = lat, data = d)
}
```

# 1. Gender

```{r gender}
mi_g3 <- mi_sequence(MODELS$corr3,  P$gender, "gender, correlated three-factor")
mi_g1 <- mi_sequence(MODELS$unidim, P$gender, "gender, unidimensional")
```

## Partial invariance: which items' thresholds drive the scalar misfit?

Each item's three thresholds are released in turn from the scalar model
(correlated three-factor, gender) and compared with the full scalar model.

```{r partial}
d <- mi_g3$data; f_sc <- mi_g3$fits$scalar
part <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ITEMS, function(it) {
  fp <- fit_mg(MODELS$corr3, d, "scalar", free_thr = it)
  lrt <- lavaan::lavTestLRT(fp, f_sc)
  data.frame(item = it, dchisq = lrt[2, "Chisq diff"], ddf = lrt[2, "Df diff"], p = lrt[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"])
}))
part$p_bh <- p.adjust(part$p, "BH")
part <- part[order(-part$dchisq), ]
print(format(part, digits = 3), row.names = FALSE)
top4 <- part$item[1:4]
fp4 <- fit_mg(MODELS$corr3, d, "scalar", free_thr = top4)
cat("\nPartial scalar model freeing", paste(top4, collapse = ", "), ":\n")
print(round(fmeas(fp4), 4)); print(lavaan::lavTestLRT(fp4, f_sc))
pe4 <- lavaan::parameterEstimates(fp4)
lat4 <- sapply(c("DEP", "ANX", "STR"), function(v) pe4$est[pe4$op == "~1" & pe4$lhs == v & pe4$group == 2])
cat("Latent means of group 2, partial model:", round(lat4, 3),
    "| full scalar:", round(mi_g3$latent$mean_g2, 3), "\n")
```

## Observed sum scores versus latent means

Scalar invariance licenses comparing **latent** means. Whether **observed** sum
scores are comparable also depends on whether the residual threshold differences
cancel or accumulate. A direct check: the standardised group difference on the
observed sum scores next to the latent mean difference.

```{r sum-vs-latent}
obs_d <- sapply(names(SCALES), function(s) {
  x <- P$sums[[s]]; g <- P$gender
  (mean(x[g == "Group 2"]) - mean(x[g == "Group 1"])) /
    sqrt((var(x[g == "Group 1"]) + var(x[g == "Group 2"])) / 2)
})
data.frame(scale = names(SCALES), observed_d = round(obs_d, 3),
           latent_mean_scalar = round(mi_g3$latent$mean_g2, 3),
           latent_mean_partial = round(lat4, 3), row.names = NULL)
```

# 2. Bonus: age (median split, exploratory)

```{r age}
mi_a3 <- mi_sequence(MODELS$corr3,  P$age_grp, "age, correlated three-factor")
mi_a1 <- mi_sequence(MODELS$unidim, P$age_grp, "age, unidimensional")
```

# 3. Numbers for the essay and save

```{r numbers}
store <- function(mi, pre) {
  tb <- mi$tab; dl <- mi$deltas
  for (s in c("configural", "metric", "scalar", "strict")) {
    S <- tools::toTitleCase(s)
    num(paste0(pre, S, "Chi"), formatC(tb[s, "chisq.scaled"], format = "f", digits = 1))
    num(paste0(pre, S, "df"),  tb[s, "df.scaled"])
    num(paste0(pre, S, "CFI"), dec(tb[s, "cfi.scaled"], 3))
    num(paste0(pre, S, "RMSEA"), dec(tb[s, "rmsea.scaled"], 3))
    num(paste0(pre, S, "CFIrob"), dec(tb[s, "cfi.robust"], 3))
    num(paste0(pre, S, "RMSEArob"), dec(tb[s, "rmsea.robust"], 3))
  }
  rows <- c(Metric = 1, Scalar = 2, Strict = 3, ConfScalar = 4)
  sg <- function(x) sub("^([+-])0\\.", "\\1.", sprintf("%+.3f", x))
  for (k in names(rows)) {
    r <- dl[rows[k], ]
    num(paste0(pre, k, "dChi"), formatC(r$dchisq, format = "f", digits = 1))
    num(paste0(pre, k, "ddf"), r$ddf)
    num(paste0(pre, k, "dp"), if (r$p < .001) "<.001" else dec(r$p, 3))
    num(paste0(pre, k, "dCFI"), sg(r$dCFI_scaled)); num(paste0(pre, k, "dRMSEA"), sg(r$dRMSEA_scaled))
    num(paste0(pre, k, "dCFIrob"), sg(r$dCFI_robust)); num(paste0(pre, k, "dRMSEArob"), sg(r$dRMSEA_robust))
  }
}
store(mi_g3, "MI"); store(mi_g1, "MIU"); store(mi_a3, "MIAge"); store(mi_a1, "MIAgeU")
for (k in 1:3) num(paste0("Kappa", names(SCALES)[k]), f2(mi_g3$latent$mean_g2[k]))
num("KappaUni", f2(mi_g1$latent$mean_g2))
for (k in 1:3) num(paste0("KappaAge", names(SCALES)[k]), f2(mi_a3$latent$mean_g2[k]))
num("PartialItems", paste(sub("dass", "", top4), collapse = ", "))
num("PartialTopItem", sub("dass", "", part$item[1]))
num("PartialTopChi", formatC(part$dchisq[1], format = "f", digits = 1))
strip <- function(mi) { mi$fits <- lapply(mi$fits, function(f) lavaan::fitMeasures(f)); mi$data <- NULL; mi }
saveRDS(list(gender_corr3 = strip(mi_g3), gender_unidim = strip(mi_g1),
             age_corr3 = strip(mi_a3), age_unidim = strip(mi_a1),
             partial = part, partial_top4 = list(items = top4, fit = fmeas(fp4), latent = lat4),
             sum_vs_latent = obs_d),
        file.path(RES, "invariance.rds"))
log_close()
```
